lean_source:
import ProofLab.Bridge

set_option maxHeartbeats 300000
theorem prooflab_result (P Q R : Prop) (h : P ∨ Q) (hp : P → R) (hq : Q → R) : R := by
  rcases h with h0 | h1
  apply hp
  assumption
  apply hq
  assumption

#prooflab_audit prooflab_result
